subject: general
question: On the MS PowerPoint 2019 home screen, which option or section should you click to start a new blank presentation when the 'Start Screen' is enabled?

options.text: The Design tab from the ribbon
The Recent tab in the left sidebar
The Open button at the bottom left corner
The tile labeled 'Blank Presentation' on the right panel

solution:
The Correct answer is __**The tile labeled 'Blank Presentation' on the right panel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When the **'Start Screen'** is enabled in **MS PowerPoint 2019**, users are presented with a home screen that provides several options to get started.
 
• To create a new blank presentation, you need to click on the tile labeled **'Blank Presentation'**, which is located in the **right panel** of the Start Screen.
 
• This option allows users to start with a completely new and fresh presentation without any pre-designed themes or templates.
 
• The **'Blank Presentation'** tile is designed for users who prefer to customize their slides from scratch.
 
• It provides a clean slate with default settings, such as a white background and basic slide layouts.
 
• Starting with a **blank presentation** is ideal for users who want full control over the design and content of their slides.
 
• The Start Screen is a feature introduced to improve user experience by offering quick access to recent files, templates, and blank presentations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The Design tab from the ribbon**__

 __
 
• The **Design tab** in MS PowerPoint allows users to customize the appearance of their slides by applying themes, colors, and background styles.
 
• It is not used to create a new blank presentation but rather to modify the design of an existing presentation.
 
 
 
• **The Recent tab in the left sidebar**__
 __
 
• The **Recent tab** displays a list of recently opened presentations for quick access.
 
• It is useful for reopening previous presentations but does not provide an option to start a new blank presentation.
 
 
 
• **The Open button at the bottom left corner**__
 
 
• The **Open button** allows users to browse and open existing files stored on their computer or cloud services.
 
• It is not intended for creating new blank presentations.
